title: Delicate British Leaf Tarts
description: A classic French dessert with a delicate British twist, these leaf tarts are a delight to make and eat.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out small squares of pastry, about 3 inches per side.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and heavy cream until well combined.
Place a small spoonful of the egg mixture onto one half of each square of pastry.
Top with a few fresh thyme leaves.
Fold the other half of the pastry square over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the tarts with a little bit of butter.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Allow the tarts to cool on a wire rack for a few minutes before serving.
